items.title: Stripe didn’t really buy OpenRouter because of the ‘singularity’
items.summary: What does a payments giant want with a startup that routes prompts between different AI models? Stripe says it's because of "the singularity" but it's really for a far more real and powerful reason.

items.summary: A competition is developing between OpenAI and Anthropic over who can provide the best privacy protections for enterprise customer data.

items.title: Cognition CEO denies report that SpaceX tried to acquire the startup
items.summary: SpaceX was reportedly in talks to buy AI coding startup Cognition. SpaceX has already acquired Cursor as it races to catch up to rivals like OpenAI and Anthropic in enterprise AI.

items.title: AI was supposed to win people over by now — it hasn’t
items.summary: As AI becomes harder to avoid, consumers are growing more wary of the technology — and Silicon Valley is discovering that widespread adoption doesn’t necessarily lead to acceptance.

items.title: Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models

items.title: Google packs Search and Gemini with new AI study tools
items.summary: The launch of the new study features marks Google's latest effort to make Gemini the AI assistant that students turn to when learning and studying, as it continues to compete with companies like OpenAI.

items.title: Researchers say OpenAI revoked their access to limited cyber program
items.summary: The idea behind OpenAI's Trusted Access for Cyber program is to give trusted defenders better models so they can report bugs and vulnerabilities to companies, with the aim of getting flaws patched faster.
